title: Strengthening corporate governance: military experience on boards and audit quality in earnings management
core_idea: Investigate how military-affiliated board membership and audit quality relate to accrual-based and real earnings management in non-financial firms listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange (2010–2022), framed within upper echelons theory and governance challenges in emerging markets.
tldr: This study examines whether military experience on corporate boards, together with external audit quality, is associated with differences in accrual and real earnings management in Pakistani non-financial firms between 2010 and 2022.
